findings.finding: DigiCat/DigiFile/Learning are already defined centrally in the repository architecture and native system catalogue.
The searched application/system trees do not currently expose direct DigiCat/DigiFile/Learning implementation files under each family path.
Central learning implementations exist under intelligence/ and software/rnd-os-ai/ and are governed by Core/DMS promotion boundaries.
DigiCat and DigiFile are currently registered as catalogue/evidence roles rather than per-application duplicated implementations.
Runtime/build evidence remains open for Android and other system families; source presence must not be promoted to runtime verification.
A common benchmark contract is required before comparing AS-IS functionality and full native integration performance.

next_gate: map every application to canonical DigiCat/DigiFile/Learning interfaces
only then create AS-IS functionality tree and full-integration performance tree
